Meeting, email and CRM integrations require scoped access; generated outputs are drafts for review.

tools.name: Nabla
tools.userValue: For clinicians who want to reduce documentation time while staying focused on the patient. Audio is not retained by default; clinical notes are retained for 14 days by default and retention is configurable. Patient consent is required in many jurisdictions, and clinicians must review and approve all generated notes, instructions and coding suggestions before clinical use.
